title: Learning in Large Populations With Anticipatory Payoffs: Bregman Meets Willems and Lyapunov
summary: We study evolutionary Nash equilibrium learning in large populations whose payoffs are generated by dynamic mechanisms. Counterclockwise dissipativity (CCW) provides a passivity-like framework for establishing learning/convergence under a broad convex cone of so-called well-behaved learning rules satisfying a natural payoff-alignment condition according to which, away from equilibria, the population's state (strategic profile) moves in a direction positively correlated with the payoffs.
